query:
DELETE FROM user_tasks WHERE task_id = (
                        SELECT task_id FROM user_tasks 
                        WHERE user_id = ? 
                        ORDER BY 
                            CASE 
                                WHEN terminated_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
                                WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 2 
                                ELSE 3 
                            END ASC, 
                            task_id ASC 
                        LIMIT 1
                    )
